mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Current records (default), or only the records added, removed or changed since a date — schedule a daily run in changes mode to monitor the register and pay only for what changed.

since.title: Changes since
since.description: Changes mode only: YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the last 7 days. The feed keeps 90 days.

change.title: Change type
change.description: Changes mode only: one kind of change. Default: all three.

rating_value.title: Rating
rating_value.description: Exact rating to return: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, AwaitingInspection, Exempt, Pass (Scotland) or Improvement Required (Scotland). Leave empty for all.

business_type.title: Business type contains
business_type.description: e.g. Restaurant, Takeaway, Pub, Retailers, Hospitals, School, Mobile caterer

outward_code.title: Postcode area (outward code)
outward_code.description: e.g. LS1, SW1A, M1. Matches the start of the postcode.

rating_date_after.title: Inspected on or after
rating_date_after.description: YYYY-MM-DD — only businesses inspected on or after this date (new ratings, recent changes).

new_rating_pending.title: Only businesses with a new rating pending
new_rating_pending.description: A newer inspection result is awaiting publication.

q.title: Free-text search
q.description: Matches any text field (name, address, type, authority).

max_results.title: Maximum results
max_results.description: Stop after this many records (you are charged per result).
